texts:
Websites have mascots. three.ws pages have agents that physically show up.

This one swings in from off screen on a rope, hits the button, watches it wobble back into place, and then just hangs there. A real 3D character rendered over the page in WebGL, not a video.

It is one of a set of interaction prototypes for 3D agents on ordinary web pages: entrances, pick-ups, face mocap and more.

Play with all of them: three.ws/demos/agents

issues.problem: The spelling check failed on "mocap". It is common industry shorthand, but the live page itself describes this demo as "Webcam drives the avatar's face in real time via ARKit blendshapes", so use words drawn straight from the product to keep the post clean for a partner audience.
issues.fix: Replace "face mocap" with "webcam facial capture via ARKit blendshapes", which matches the verified index.html text word for word.
